---

Jab Riza Rab Se Thi Payi Sheh Ne.
Karbala Aa Ke Basai Sheh Ne.

1
Bola Gehware Se Labaik Ali.
Di Jo Hal Min Dohai Sheh Ne.
Lash Akbar Ki Utha Kar Kar Di.
Sar Hairan Khudai Sheh Ne.

2
Pocha Farwa Ne Kahan Hai Qasim.
Khool Ke Ghatri Dikhai Sheh Ne.
Tapti Raiti Ke Tale Kaise Thi.
Lash Asghar Ki Chupai Sheh Ne.

3
Bhaij Ke Sare Jawaan Baad Mein Phir.
Bhaija Abbas Sa Bahi Sheh Ne.
Nook-e-Naiza Se Sar Kofa-o-Shaam.
Haan Sana Rab Ki Sunai Sheh Ne.

4
Kar Ke Qurban Ridaye Zainab.
Deen Ki Laaj Bachai Sheh Ne.
Keh Do Afraz Jahan Se Janat.
Karbala Mein Hai Basai Sheh Ne.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/jab-riza-rab-se-thi-payi-sheh-ne-tajpoints-2a866a624b880017cb0e.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True)
_, metadata, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
normalize = lambda s: [line.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
assert normalize(roman) == normalize(old.split('---', 2)[2])
shape = lambda s: [len(block.splitlines()) for block in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert shape(roman) == shape(body) == [2,5,5,5,5]
assert [block.splitlines()[0] for block in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴')
print('Verified original Roman wording and matching Urdu layout: two opening verses and four four-verse stanzas.')

Reconstructed the Urdu title and all 18 verses in the selected Markdown. Moved the original Roman wording into `romanLyrics`, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed `noUrdu`. Verified that both versions have the same verse and stanza layout.

I read “Hal Min” as ہل من and “Bahi” as بھائی.
